description: Japan company financial figures, newest period first. Consolidated EDINET filers. Since April 2024, filings carry full-year and half-year figures only. Free with no sign-in: 7974 (Nintendo), 6501 (Hitachi), 8035 (Tokyo Electron), 6861 (Keyence). One page via limit/cursor. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess) and can change or disappear when a later filing arrives. Figures follow the source, including any adjustments described with the figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.

id.description: A 4-character ticker (7203), an EDINET code (E02144) or a 13-digit corporate number.
